sn35.242:1.1: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Kimbilāyaṃ viharati Gaṅgāya nadiyā tire || 2
sn35.242:1.2: Addasā kho Bhagavā mahantam dārukkhandhaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānaṃ ||
sn35.242:1.4: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave amum mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānan ti || ||
sn35.242:1.6: Evaṃ vutte āyasma Kimbilo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.242:1.7: Kiṃ nu kho bhante orimantīram || || Vitthāretabbo || pe || 12
sn35.242:1.9: Idha Kimbila bhikkhu aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭham āpattim āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānam paññāyati ||
